content.short: Ultimate is a multi-chain non-custodial wallet that makes DeFi trading accessible to the masses.
content.description: Ultimate is the first product developed and launched by Berlin-based Unstoppable Finance. Unstoppable Finance’s mission is to empower people worldwide to access and unlock financial opportunities in the decentralized economy. Ultimate is a multi-chain, fully non-custodial wallet that makes the expanding world of DeFi trading accessible to a broad audience by reducing complexity and giving users direct control over their assets. It supports multiple chains and prioritizes straightforward access to decentralized finance.
